name: Ooedo Tantei Kamiya Ukyou Vol. 1
original_name: 大江戸探偵 神谷右京 Ｖｏｌ１
source:
Detective Kamiya Ukyo is asked for an investigation, but the client is killed. There was Ukyo name in the will, so agency took up the case.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-september-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
偵探神谷右京受人委託調查一樁案子，委託人卻遭人殺害。由於死者的遺囑中出現了右京的名字，偵探事務所決定接手案件。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-september-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
